stem.text: A police car has a two-tone siren emitting sound of frequencies of $700\,\text{Hz}$ and $1000\,\text{Hz}$.
The police car is travelling at a speed of $40.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ towards a stationary observer. The speed of sound in the air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the difference between the two frequencies of the sound that is heard by the observer?
